acceptedAnswer.text: The cost to repair a leaky roof in Pasadena can vary significantly depending on several factors, including the size and location of the leak, the type of roofing material (e.g., asphalt shingles, tile, metal), and the extent of any underlying damage to the decking or attic. Minor patch repairs might cost a few hundred dollars, while more extensive issues or structural damage could range into thousands. We provide a detailed estimate after a thorough inspection, ensuring transparency and accuracy for your specific situation.
